scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @sistema-ats/backend && npm run build --workspace @sistema-ats/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @sistema-ats/backend && npm run typecheck --workspace @sistema-ats/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.format: prettier --write frontend/src frontend/*.json frontend/*.ts docs/*.md *.json *.yaml README.md && npm run format --workspace @sistema-ats/backend
scripts.format:check: prettier --check frontend/src frontend/*.json frontend/*.ts docs/*.md *.json *.yaml README.md && npm run format:check --workspace @sistema-ats/backend
